mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "stockId" ,SYMBOL AS "symbol" ,NAME AS "name" FROM T_STOCK WHERE ID = #{stockId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (N.TITLE) N.TITLE AS "title" ,N.PRESS AS "press" ,N.LINK AS "link" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM N.PUB_DATE) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "pubAt" FROM T_NEWS N WHERE 1=1 AND N.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND N.PUB_DATE >= NOW() - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => #{days}) ORDER BY N.TITLE, N.PUB_DATE DESC ) X ORDER BY "pubAt" DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS "posts" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE OPINION = 'UP')::INT AS "up" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE OPINION = 'DOWN')::INT AS "down" FROM T_STOCK_POST WHERE 1=1 AND STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => #{days})

SELECT P.CONTENT FROM T_STOCK_POST P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND P.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT R WHERE R.POST_ID = P.ID AND R.STATUS = 'OPEN') < 3 ORDER BY P.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT BRIEF_JSON AS "briefJson" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INS_DAY)) / 60)::INT AS "ageMinutes" FROM T_STOCK_BRIEF WHERE STOCK_ID = #{stockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_STOCK_BRIEF (STOCK_ID, BRIEF_JSON) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{briefJson}) ON CONFLICT (STOCK_ID) DO UPDATE SET BRIEF_JSON = EXCLUDED.BRIEF_JSON ,INS_DAY = NOW()
